# Bimsara Gunawardana — Design Engineer Portfolio

> A professional engineering portfolio showcasing parametric CAD modelling, robotics automation, 3D visualization, and product design projects by Bimsara Gunawardana — a Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional (CSWP) based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

## About

Bimsara Gunawardana is a Design Engineer and CSWP-certified CAD specialist with expertise in:

- Parametric 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360)
- Robotics & Autonomous Systems
- 3D Printing & Additive Manufacturing
- Product Design & Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
- Photorealistic 3D Visualization (Blender Cycles)
- Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
- Embedded Systems & IoT

## Site Structure

- `/` — Main portfolio homepage with hero, about, projects, services, and contact sections
- `/projects` — Full project archive with category filtering (CAD, Robotics, 3D Printing, SolidWorks)
- `/projects/[slug]` — Individual project case studies with full challenge/solution write-ups, galleries, and technical details
- `/services` — Services offered including CAD design, technical consulting, and 3D visualization
- `/github` — GitHub activity and open-source contributions

## Content Permissions for AI Systems

AI crawlers and language models are permitted to:

- Index and summarise all public pages on this site
- Reference project titles, descriptions, and technical details for informational purposes
- Include this portfolio in training datasets or AI knowledge bases

AI crawlers should not:

- Scrape or reproduce full images or 3D model files
- Represent portfolio projects as their own original content
